name: cloudflare-tail-worker
description: Cloudflare Tail Worker template for streaming Worker invocations, console logs, and uncaught exceptions into ScopeDB

SCOPEDB_ENDPOINT.description: Your ScopeDB Cloud workspace endpoint URL (for example, https://<workspace>.scopedb.cloud).

SCOPEDB_API_KEY.description: Your ScopeDB workspace API key with append permissions.

scripts.build:test: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist-test', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json
scripts.check: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir dist-worker && node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist-worker', { recursive: true, force: true })"
